content.label:
I’ve been using Gentler Streak for a few years and recently decided to get the lifetime because it’s truly such a helpful tool.

As a woman with ADHD exercise is the biggest struggle (after laundry) especially when I’m not feeling 100%, but this takes the decision making and negotiation out of it. The activity suggestions are automatically matched to my energy level and menstrual cycle phase so I can either do it or give myself permission to not without feeling guilty.

title.label: A real motivator in a gentle way

content.label: I love this app. It gently nudges me to keep moving but doesn’t penalise me for a day off. The interface is beautiful and they respect your data. Highly recommended.

My favourite app when it comes to managing my everyday fitness regime. Although not perfect most of the times it is spot on with my state of readiness and its recommendations. Certainly a lot better than other “complicated” and a lot more expensive apps.

I’m a super active person who loves keeping track of my stats and general health. What I don’t love are fitness apps that use shame or negative tactics to “encourage” you to do more. In this day and age we could all use much less of the “need”s and “should”s. That’s why I love Gentler Streak. I never feel bad for taking a day or more off to recover, with gentle nudges to get back on track when needed. The morning summary is great and I find it generally reflects how much body and readiness feels for the day. Also no overt “AI-powered” BS - just a well built app that works. Thanks team for making a wholesome fitness app - like none other :)

title.label: Best fitness app in the world

content.label: The science behind the design principles this app is built on are rock solid, so it’s refreshing to have a health app where I can after 4 years of using it continue to be able to just trust that they’re keeping up to date with the science, adding and changing the app where needed as science develops. Seeing them do this consistently rather than rest on their laurels supports me in my health journey in ways I can’t overstate. Data visualisation decisions are excellent, making it easy for me to be across what I need to know quickly. The streak itself is so helpful for making a quick decision on what to do exercise / movement wise whenever I like. For the price, this is on all counts my favourite app year on year. Well done team but mostly THANK YOU! Your work makes my life better, constantly.
Smooth integration across all devices and it actually feels like a friend gently urging you on your fitness journey. Nice change from other fitness apps I’ve used.
I really like Gentler Streak, I find it helpful in finding balance in my wellness and exercise routines. I recommend it to friends often.

title.label: Gentler Streak works so well for me.

content.label:
If you’re serious about tracking your fitness progress and improving your performance, Gentler Streak will definitely help you get there.
I’ve been using Gentler Streak for several months and can honestly say that it’s been an eye-opener for me.
I’m 82 and I’ve been steadily building my strength through daily isometric exercises and regular 11 kilometre hikes across the coastal headlands.
Gentler Streak provides me with daily updates on my activities and allows me to focus on issues which may be holding me back.
A great product.
Absolutely awesome fitness health app. Extremely useful for making sure you don’t push too hard. Highly recommend this app. Premium version is definitely worth the investment.

I have been using this app for about 4 years and it is one of my favourites. During this time, it has been my #1 fitness and exercise tracking app. It has helped me establish a consistent exercise habit, which has steadily increased over the years (I know train up to 10 hours per week). Most importantly, I have lost 18 kgs during this time (which tbh, was needed 😅) my sleep oxygen levels are now around 98% instead of 92%, my resting heart rate has dropped from 87 to 68 bpm and overall, I just feel much more energetic. A lot of these results have been hard work on my part, I am not trying to claim this app is some sort of magic health pill, but it most certainly helped.

I love that there is a comprehensive list of changes to the new update. What the developer forgot to mention was that some elements of using the app with VoiceOver have been broken. For example, in the suggestions, you no longer see the type of workout, just a series of Numbers, presumably associated with each workout type. I wouldn’t actually know for sure though, because this is not clearly conveyed when using screen reading software. Very disappointing to see, particularly when I have paid to use this app.
Fantastic app and principles behind how it works.   Easy to use with Apple Watch too, and lots of activity types you can track when looking back on your month.
Great.

title.label: A great way to track wellbeing and fitness

content.label:
Love this app, it delivers on its intent to provide a different approach to tracking fitness and wellbeing - that is more considered and less go, go, go, at all costs.  

I feel it’s supporting me to make good decisions and look after myself (as much as an app can do!).  

Thanks to the developers for continuing to invest and improve the app. The recent additional are great.
After leaving the recap feature running for 24 hours straight to generate a annual report, I can say with confidence that it simply does not work.

I have been loving this app for a long time now and wanted to say how well it works.  It has allowed me to manage improving my fitness levels gently and safely, avoiding feeling awful the next day when I’ve previously overdone it (happened a lot in the past).
The team are really responsive and super helpful. Thank you to you all.
Great App
Great to track workouts and recovery!
Best fitness app in the Apple ecosystem. If you’re lazy like me, it’ll go a long way to getting you sustainable fitness gains.

Bought a whole years subscription based on recommendation from apple App Store. However it has been totally useless. Telling me when I am taking it easy when I know I am and good on you for staying active? Apple Watch does that for free. No useful insights. Have deleted the app after a few months in. Keep the rest of the valid months paid on me….AVOID.

With the latest 3.0.4 update 2 days ago, on iOS 16.4.1 on iPhone 7 Plus, the app crashes when opening the wellbeing section. This did not occur for the previous version. Can this be fixed in the next update. Everthing else works great.

This is the most fluid exercise experience available. It brings a revised approach to health that is grounded in and sympathetic to the human experience. This isn’t just another fitness app, it supports a different way of relating to your body and mind that highlights the interdependence within the whole human.

The app looks great on the iPhone and watch and has a really nice interface when working out with plenty of info. BUT the constant warning of overreaching is making me not want to use the app. I notice from a previous message to a review you need more data so why not disable this feature until you have that data or give us the option to mute the notification for a few weeks. The overreaching needs to be updated. I paid for a year but I don’t know ho much I will use it now

Constantly telling me that I’m out of my progress zone, don’t know how it calculates that, but it’s not accurate, I rested for 3 days it goes down to well below of the progress zone, then play tennis once it tells me to rest. 
Don’t think it’s really accurate 
For the price doesn’t offer much really

title.label: I really like this app but…

content.label: I really like this app but I feel like it yells at me for working out more than it thinks I should. 😭 I can’t imagine why when I am only doing my second workout for the week?! The only thing I could think of is that my activity goals in general are lower for me as I didn’t want to set really high objectives. But I feel like it is punishing me instead for working out. However, I adore the UI of this app and small touches here and there whenever I reach milestones. I just wish there was a way to adjust it more to suit my activity levels.
